summary: Server one-frame event on a stack entity: the entities that were merged into it. Born with AddTreasureRequest/GeneratedAsTreasure during treasure generation (stackable items merge). Toolkit esv::StoryItemEventManager::OnStackedWith(EntityHandle, DynamicArray<esv::inventory::StackMergedEntityData>) throws the Osiris StackedWith event per element.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: First qword of esv::inventory::StackMergedEntityData; not passed to ThrowStackedWith and trivially destructible. Probably the merged (destroyed) entity; not confirmed.

fields.name: TemplateName
fields.evidence: OnStackedWith (EoCServer.dll+0xEBF200) passes element+8 as the ls::STDString const& argument of ThrowStackedWith(STDString const&, Guid const&, EntityHandle); bg3.exe element destructor FUN_1422e2e70 frees the string buffer at +8 when the capacity at +0x1C > 15. The name is a guess at what the string holds.

fields.name: Uuid
fields.evidence: OnStackedWith passes element+0x20 as the Guid argument of ThrowStackedWith.

fields.name: MergedEntities
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator 0x34B35E0 zeroes a 16-byte Array; destructor FUN_1422cf840 -> FUN_1422e2e70 with element stride 0x30 and an STDString at +8. Toolkit OnStackedWith iterates DynamicArray<StackMergedEntityData> with stride 0x30. Live (48 instances): capacity 1..0x40, size 1..0x2D.

open_questions: That this component's array is exactly the DynamicArray<StackMergedEntityData> passed to OnStackedWith (stride and STDString position match).
Meaning of the first qword and of the string.
